svg.title: The first Hùng King
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene in the land of Văn Lang: golden rice fields, stilt houses with saddle-shaped roofs, and green hills. In the middle stands the eldest son, now a grown-up king, in a gold tunic and a tall feather crown of white fairy feathers and teal dragon feathers, smiling with his arms open. Beside him Âu Cơ smiles proudly. A bronze drum stands nearby, and a villager and a child cheer.
